about: Oromocto is a town in New Brunswick at the Oromocto River’s meeting with the St. John River, immediately southeast of Fredericton and beside CFB Gagetown. Planned as a model military town, it mixes base housing, a commercial core, and riverfront parks. About 9,000 people live in Oromocto.
seoSummary: New Brunswick town beside CFB Gagetown—planned military community at the Oromocto and St. John rivers, near Fredericton.
